name: Milton Sheaf
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Milton Sheaf tends the Royal Library and calls on Alliance travelers to recover lost books and records.

sections.title: The Caretaker of Stormwind's History
sections.body: Milton Sheaf tends the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep. While the court weighs politics, noble disputes, and military concerns, he preserves the written record. To him, accurate histories of the Alliance and the Eastern Kingdoms are a duty, especially amid war, loss, and instability.

sections.title: Recovering Lost Tomes
sections.body: Milton Sheaf sends travelers across the realm to recover scattered books. Volumes wear with use, while records rest in monastic archives, distant outposts, and forgotten ruins. From Northshire Abbey to Southshore in the north, he sends Alliance adventurers to retrieve misplaced books, examine ancient texts, and return rare manuscripts safely to the keep.

faq.answer: Milton Sheaf is a human scholar who tends the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City. He manages the kingdom's books and chronicles.

faq.q: Where can I find Milton Sheaf?
faq.answer: Milton Sheaf can be found in the Royal Library wing of Stormwind Keep, just off the main palace corridors.

faq.q: Why does Milton Sheaf need adventurers?
faq.answer: Milton Sheaf relies on traveling Alliance adventurers to find historical manuscripts, replace damaged books, and work with scholars and priests across the kingdom to grow the Royal Library's archives.

faq.q: Does Milton Sheaf interact with other scholars in the kingdom?
faq.answer: Milton Sheaf keeps ties with monastic archivists and religious scholars, including Brother Paxton in Northshire Valley. Together, they preserve sacred teachings and historical records.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can help Milton Sheaf preserve the recorded heritage of the human kingdoms and the wider Alliance.
As a human, you share the history Milton Sheaf safeguards. He preserves chronicles that survived Stormwind's fall and rebuilding.
